counter_definitions.affected_task_observations: task observations affected by a request or semantic response failure
counter_definitions.model_runtime_failures: request-level non-schema failures before a parsed response
counter_definitions.request_attempts: provider attempts reported by the gateway
counter_definitions.request_start_failures: request records with no successful inference response
counter_definitions.semantic_response_failures: successful inference responses rejected by task-local parsing
counter_definitions.successful_inference_requests: request records with a parsed inference response
